scope: Untextured mannequin with complete requested animation vocabulary, not final painted hero or APK.

reference.scope: Isolated native desktop import/playback and dependency-complete resource pack. No APK, final paint or mobile profiling.

balanced.scope: Isolated native desktop import/playback and dependency-complete resource pack. No APK, final paint or mobile profiling.

compact.scope: Isolated native desktop import/playback and dependency-complete resource pack. No APK, final paint or mobile profiling.

recommendation: 128 reference density, 16 images per walk/run cycle, 8 idle, 7 hurt, 12 per lockpick/loot loop, 13 fall, one reused corpse image. Provisional until final art and phone review.
limits: PNG compression of the clay mannequin is not a prediction of painted texture compression.
RGBA numbers are texture storage only, excluding engine, CPU staging copies, objects and other game content.
The PCK contains animation resources, imported textures and import remaps; it excludes the engine, sound and APK container.
Four views and all clips are included in memory totals. Multiple instances can share these resources; independently painted hero types require their own atlas pixels.
Native sampling confirms crop anchors, loops and final holds, not gesture quality or gameplay integration.
Game displacement speed has not been changed or synchronized to this prototype gait.
Portrait/physical phone performance, final lock/hand positioning, clothes and facial animation remain unvalidated.
